name: OcelotDex
rootCause: OcelotDex suffered an Ethereum exploit on 2024-09-20 that multiple incident catalogues classify as an infinite mint or token accounting failure. Publicly available evidence remains limited. No primary postmortem, verified vulnerable contract, or confirmed exploit transaction was located during research. Public exploit catalogues consistently classify the incident as an infinite mint tied to token or share accounting logic on Ethereum. The exact vulnerable contract, function, and historical code path have not been publicly established in the available evidence.
